name: Block Token
description: Allows you to create the tokens for blocks on site.
project_description:
The Block Token module allows you to create the tokens for blocks on site. 

 Back to top 

 Key Features 
 
 Specify the blocks that will have the tokens generated for 
 (Optional) Use the tokens within text formats using Token Filter module 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Block 
 Token 
 (Optional) Token Filter 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage with Token Filter 
 
 Enable "Replace Tokens" filter for specific text formats. E.g. for full_html on /admin/config/content/formats/full_html 
 Check the "Create the token for this block" checkbox for the block on edit screen. 
 Put the token of enabled block, e.g. [block_token:system:navigation] , to the content field formatted with the text format with token replacement. 
 Back to top
